parts.text:
Mourning did not slow their steps. Instead, it made every survivor see clearly what they are fighting for.
Marching on in the name of the fallen, they let the still-burning flames light the way to a tomorrow yet to come.

#### Born Toward the Flame

**Mavuika:** Light of the blazing sun!

**Monster:** Raargh!

**Natlan Warrior:** We did it... We won!

**Fontaine Warrior:** Yes!

**Sumeru Warrior:** Alright!

**Natlan Warrior:** It was all... worth it...

**Sethos:** According to the Akademiya's calculations and the divinations of the Masters of the Night-Wind, once we deal with the Ley Line Outcrop here, we should gradually be able to bring any subsequent disasters under control.

**Citlali:** Slowly but surely, the Hallowing's damage to the Night Kingdom is also easing up...

**Mavuika:** That's great news. I can't thank you enough, friends from afar. Natlan will not forget your support.

**[Name]:** No need to thank us. Natlan was there in Sumeru's time of need as well. We're just returning the favor.

**Ineffa:** Camaraderie means doing our utmost for each other in times of need... Each individual becomes part of something greater, and no nation is left to stand on its own. That is how it should be.

**Furina:** Well said! I think we all deserve to be proud of what we've accomplished so far!

- **Traveler:** That doesn't mean the war is won...

**Mavuika:** You're right, Traveler. So long as the Nail of Retribution remains in the Night Kingdom, the threat of the Hallowing will persist.

**Mavuika:** But a victory is a victory, no matter how small. And every moment of peace should be cherished, no matter how brief.

**Mavuika:** I can't say what tomorrow holds. All I know is this... At least for today, the people of Natlan— No, the people of all nations will have a night of peace, free from monsters and free from fear. For now, that is enough.

**Furina:** Exactly! Besides, who says the only time you can give a round of applause is after a show is all over?

**Mavuika:** Well said. So, let's celebrate this victory to our heart's content... and do our utmost to make this peace a lasting one.
